title: Deferred Fixed Annuities Owner Guide Table: Withdrawal and Distribution Limits
content:
Withdrawal and distribution limits of Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities, by tier. Amounts are in US dollars.

## Free withdrawals and withdrawal minimums

| Tier | Free withdrawal percentage | First contract year in which the free withdrawal amount is available | Unused free amount carries into the next contract year | Smallest partial withdrawal | Contract value that must remain after a partial withdrawal | Smallest systematic withdrawal installment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity | 10% (0.10) | 1 | No | $500 | $2000 | $100 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 3 | 10% (0.10) | 2 | No | $500 | $5000 | $100 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 5 | 10% (0.10) | 2 | No | $500 | $5000 | $100 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 6 | 10% (0.10) | 2 | No | $500 | $5000 | $100 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 7 | 10% (0.10) | 2 | No | $500 | $5000 | $100 |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 10 | 10% (0.10) | 2 | No | $500 | $5000 | $100 |

The free withdrawal percentage is the share of the contract value on the most recent contract anniversary (the initial premium in the first contract year) that may be withdrawn each contract year without surrender charge.

## Distribution terms common to every tier

| Term | Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity and Ashgrove SecureRate 3, 5, 6, 7 and 10 |
|---|---|
| Systematic withdrawal frequencies offered | monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual |
| Required minimum distributions calculated by Ashgrove for an IRA contract free of surrender charge even above the free withdrawal amount | Yes |
| Federal withholding on the taxable part of a distribution unless the owner elects none | 10% (0.10) |
| Longest period Ashgrove may defer paying a surrender value | 180 calendar days |

## Points of reading

- The only tier differences in this table are the first contract year of the free withdrawal amount (year 1 on the Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity, year 2 on every SecureRate tier) and the contract value that must remain ($2000 against $5000).
- *Example (hypothetical):* on an Ashgrove SecureRate 5 contract in its first contract year no free withdrawal amount is available yet; on an Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity in its first contract year it is.
